edges.notes: systemd-confext and systemd-confext.service are part of the systemd suite on Linux.
Merged /etc trees can include systemd unit drop-ins and configuration consumed after confext merge.
Sysext and confext are sibling systemd extension merge mechanisms targeting different hierarchy roots per manuals.
Both layer OS-tree content on systemd hosts; portablectl attach differs from confext overlay merge.
Overlay-based merge relies on Linux mount and overlay filesystem support per systemd documentation.
Some UKI/initrd/systemd-centric flows may ship or consume configuration extensions (distro-specific).
Container-delivered config vs host /etc merge address overlapping goals with different models.
OCI layers target container roots; confext merges configuration trees on the systemd host.
